title: Devolution
tagline: An original 3D dinosaur survival game: survive the night, tame a spitfrill, found a tribe.
stateNote: Runs in the browser, solo offline or online. Works with keyboard, touch or a PlayStation controller.
problem: I wanted a survival game you can start in a browser tab on any device, alone or with real players.
audience: Players who like survival and taming games.
contribution: It is my project. Character models are by Quaternius; the world and audio are original. The source is private.
worksToday: Solo mode saves in your browser with no server.
An online mode on a persistent server, per the README.
limitations: I've checked that the title screen loads, not a full night.
